answer: Mobile driver's license gating ties each agent to one state-issued mDL under ISO 18013-5. First, the operator taps a phone wallet holding the license to the verifier's reader. Second, the reader checks the DMV signature and asks only for a unique pseudonym, never name or address. Third, that pseudonym is logged so one license backs one agent. Fourth, it's re-tapped every 30 epochs. Faking 500 agents means 500 real licenses at about $40 each plus DMV visits. It's a herbarium: each yarrow sprig is pressed and tagged to its grove, so a fake shows like violet ink on white card.
